title: E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack MERN e-commerce application with user authentication, product management, shopping cart, and secure payment integration using Stripe. Features include order tracking, admin dashboard, and real-time inventory management.

title: Task Management API
description: RESTful API built with Django and Django REST Framework. Features include JWT authentication, task CRUD operations, user management, role-based permissions, and PostgreSQL database with optimized queries.

title: Real-Time Chat Application
description: WebSocket-based chat application using React and Socket.io. Supports multiple chat rooms, private messaging, typing indicators, online user status, and message history with MongoDB persistence.

title: Analytics Dashboard
description: Data visualization dashboard built with React and Django backend. Displays real-time analytics, interactive charts, and comprehensive reports with PostgreSQL data aggregation and Chart.js visualizations.
